question: Where is the nearest café found on the south side of Medicine Park Aquarium & Natural Sciences Center, Medicine Park, OK?
sql: WITH aquarium_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Medicine Park Aquarium & Natural Sciences Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Medicine Park%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%OK%' LIMIT 1 ), aquarium_centroid AS ( SELECT ST_Centroid(geometry) AS geom FROM aquarium_location ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois AS p, aquarium_centroid AS ac WHERE p.amenity = 'cafe' AND ST_Y(ST_Centroid(p.geometry)) < ST_Y(ac.geom) -- Filter for cafes whose centroid is south of the aquarium's centroid ORDER BY p.geometry <-> (SELECT geometry FROM aquarium_location) -- Order by distance to the aquarium LIMIT 1;
